about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Lobster Bisque with Cognac Cream
recipes.summary: A velvety shellfish soup built on a roasted lobster shell stock, finished with brandy and cream.
steps: Cut the lobster tails in chunks, shell on, and sear in the butter for 4 minutes until the shells turn red, then lift out the meat once it is opaque and set aside.
Cook the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the same pot for 8 minutes until golden.
Stir in the tomato paste for 2 minutes, add the brandy and let it bubble until nearly gone.
Add the stock, thyme, bay leaf and the lobster shells and simmer for 40 minutes.
Strain the stock, pressing hard on the shells, then whisk in the rice flour and simmer for 5 minutes until lightly thickened.
Stir in the cream, cayenne and salt and add the chopped lobster meat for 1 minute until heated through.
notes: Food safety: cook the lobster until the flesh is opaque and firm.
Do not boil after adding the cream or it may split.

recipes.title: Shoyu Ramen with Ajitama Marinated Eggs
recipes.summary: A soy-seasoned chicken and kombu broth with springy noodles, a marinated jammy egg and spring onion.
steps: Simmer the stock with the kombu and shiitake for 20 minutes, then lift out the kombu and strain.
Boil the eggs for 6.5 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks jammy, then cool in iced water and peel.
Marinate the eggs in 2 tbsp soy sauce and the mirin for at least 4 hours, turning now and then.
Sear the pork belly in the sesame oil for 8 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Season the broth with the remaining soy sauce and sake and keep hot.
Cook the noodles until just tender, drain and divide among bowls.
Ladle over the hot broth and top with pork, halved eggs, nori and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches an internal temperature of 70°C, and serve jammy eggs only to healthy adults.
Marinating time is not counted in the prep time.

recipes.title: Laksa Lemak from Scratch
recipes.summary: A coconut curry noodle soup made with a fresh spice paste, prawns, tofu puffs and herbs.
steps: Blitz the shallots, garlic, galangal, lemongrass, chillies, turmeric and shrimp paste to a fine paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 8 minutes until darker and the oil separates.
Add the stock and simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in the coconut milk and fish sauce.
Cook the noodles in boiling water until tender, drain and divide among bowls.
Add the prawns and tofu puffs to the broth for 3 minutes until the prawns are pink and opaque.
Ladle over the noodles and top with sprouts, mint and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque.
Use vegetable stock and extra tofu to make it vegetarian, swapping the fish sauce for soy.

recipes.title: Pozole Rojo
recipes.summary: A hominy and pork stew in a smoky dried chilli broth, topped with cabbage, radish and lime.
steps: Simmer the pork with the onion, 3 garlic cloves and the stock for 1 hour, skimming the surface.
Blend the soaked chillies with the remaining garlic, oregano, cumin and a ladle of broth until smooth, then strain.
Stir the chilli sauce into the pot with the corn and salt.
Simmer for 1 hour more until the pork is tender and falls apart.
Serve in bowls topped with the cabbage, radish, coriander and a squeeze of lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches at least 75°C and is fork tender.
Hominy is traditional; sweetcorn is an easy swap.

recipes.title: Ham and Poached Egg Muffins with Lemon Butter Sauce
recipes.summary: Poached eggs and ham on toasted English muffins under a warm lemony hollandaise.
steps: Whisk the egg yolks and lemon juice in a heatproof bowl over a pot of barely simmering water for 4 minutes until pale and thick.
Slowly whisk in the melted butter until the sauce is glossy, then season with the cayenne and keep warm.
Bring a wide pan of water with the vinegar to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Toast the muffins until golden and top each half with ham.
Lift on the poached eggs and spoon over the hollandaise.
notes: Food safety: whisk the yolks over the heat until they reach about 70°C, and cook the poached eggs until the whites are fully set.
Serve immediately; hollandaise does not reheat well.

recipes.title: Sauce Bearnaise
recipes.summary: A classic tarragon, shallot and vinegar butter sauce for steak, asparagus and fish.
steps: Simmer the vinegar, wine, shallots, half the tarragon and the pepper for 6 minutes until reduced to about 2 tablespoons, then strain.
Melt the butter and keep warm.
Whisk the yolks with the reduction in a bowl over barely simmering water for 4 minutes until thick and pale.
Slowly whisk in the butter until glossy, then stir through the remaining tarragon and season with salt.
notes: Food safety: whisk the yolks over the heat until they reach about 70°C.
Serve warm; it splits if overheated, so whisk in a teaspoon of cold water to rescue it.

recipes.title: Crisp Fermented Dosa Rolled Around Turmeric Potato
recipes.summary: Crisp fermented rice and lentil crepes folded around a turmeric potato and onion masala.
steps: Soak the rice, lentils and fenugreek in water for 6 hours, then blend with enough water to a smooth batter and ferment covered overnight until bubbly.
Stir the salt into the batter.
Pop the mustard seeds in 1 tbsp oil for 30 seconds until they crackle, then add the curry leaves, chilli and onion and cook for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the turmeric and potatoes, mash lightly and cook for 5 minutes until fragrant, then add the coriander.
Heat a non-stick pan, pour a ladle of batter and spread thin, then drizzle with oil.
Cook for 3 minutes until crisp and golden underneath, then fill and fold.
notes: Soaking and fermenting time are not counted in the prep time.
Serve with coconut chutney or sambar.

recipes.title: Cheese Souffle with Vegetarian Hard Cheese
recipes.summary: A tall, golden souffle with a soft centre, made with vegetarian hard cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C and butter four ramekins.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk until a smooth, thick sauce forms.
Take off the heat, beat in the yolks, vegetarian hard cheese, mustard, nutmeg, cayenne and salt.
Whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form and fold in gently in two batches.
Spoon into the ramekins and bake for 20 minutes until risen and golden.
Serve straight away at the table.
notes: Food safety: bake until the souffle is set and the centre is at least 70°C, especially for anyone vulnerable.
Do not open the oven door early.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Seed Egusi-Style Soup
recipes.summary: A thick West African soup of ground seeds, tomato and greens, usually made with egusi melon seeds.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, capsicum and half the onion with the scotch bonnet until smooth.
Fry the remaining onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft, then add the blended mix and cook for 12 minutes until the oil rises to the top.
Stir in the ground seeds and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Add the chicken and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and season with salt.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
Omit the chicken for a vegan soup.

recipes.title: Beurre Blanc
recipes.summary: A light white wine and shallot butter sauce for steamed or grilled fish.
steps: Simmer the shallots, wine and vinegar for 8 minutes until reduced to about 2 tablespoons and almost syrupy.
Lower the heat and whisk in the cold butter one cube at a time until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
Season with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Strain if you want a smooth sauce and serve at once.
notes: Keep the sauce warm, not hot, or it will split.
Serve with poached salmon or asparagus.

recipes.title: Caramelised Onion Soup with Gruyere Toasts
recipes.summary: Deeply caramelised onions in beef broth, topped with a toasted cheese crouton.
steps: Cook the onions in the butter, oil and sugar over medium-low heat for 45 minutes, stirring, until deep golden brown.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then pour in the wine and let it reduce by half.
Add the stock and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes.
Heat the grill until very hot, ladle the soup into ovenproof bowls and float a slice of baguette on each.
Top with the gruyere and grill for 4 minutes until bubbling and golden.
notes: Use vegetable stock if you prefer, though the soup will taste lighter.
Gruyere is made with animal rennet, so this is not vegetarian.

recipes.title: Tomato Clam Chowder with Bacon and Thyme
recipes.summary: A tomato-based clam chowder with bacon, potato and celery, lighter than the New England style.
steps: Fry the bacon for 6 minutes until crisp, then add the onion, celery and carrot for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the tomatoes, stock, potatoes, thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the clams, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the shells have opened.
Discard any that stay shut and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the clams until their shells have opened and discard any that do not open.
Tinned clams work in a pinch, added at the end.

recipes.title: Cullen Skink Smoked Fish Soup
recipes.summary: A creamy Scottish soup of potato, onion and smoked white fish.
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the potatoes, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 12 minutes until the potato is tender.
Pour in the milk, add the fish and simmer for 5 minutes until the fish turns opaque and flakes.
Lightly crush some potato to thicken, stir in the cream and pepper and scatter with chives.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, with an internal temperature of at least 63°C.
Use smoked haddock if you can find it.

recipes.title: Mulligatawny Soup with Chicken
recipes.summary: A fragrant curried lentil soup with chicken and apple, from the Anglo-Indian kitchen.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the apple, lentils, chicken and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft and the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and blend the soup until smooth.
Return the chicken with the coconut milk and heat through, then add the lemon juice.
Serve topped with coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
Skip the chicken for a vegan soup.

recipes.title: Caldo Verde with Chorizo
recipes.summary: A Portuguese-style potato and kale soup with sliced chorizo and olive oil.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer for 18 minutes until completely tender.
Fry the chorizo in a pan for 4 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Mash or blend the soup until almost smooth, add the kale and simmer for 5 minutes until tender.
Serve topped with the chorizo and a drizzle of oil.
notes: Food safety: cook the chorizo until it reaches 75°C and is crisp.
Cut the kale very finely for the right texture.

recipes.title: Lemon Egg Thickened Chicken and Rice Soup from Greece
recipes.summary: A silky Greek soup of chicken, rice and an egg and lemon liaison.
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock for 15 minutes until cooked through, then lift out and shred.
Add the rice to the stock and cook for 12 minutes until tender.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice until frothy, then whisk in a ladle of hot stock slowly.
Pour the mixture back into the pot off the heat, stirring until the soup turns creamy and slightly thickened.
Return the chicken, season and top with dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and do not boil the soup after adding the egg or it will curdle.
The egg cooks gently from the heat of the soup.

recipes.title: Lamb Harira
recipes.summary: A Moroccan soup of lamb, lentils, chickpeas, tomato and warm spices, traditionally served to break the Ramadan fast.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil for 6 minutes until coloured, then add the onion, celery and spices for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, lentils and water and simmer for 35 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes until the lamb is tender and the lentils are soft.
Finish with the lemon juice and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until tender, with an internal temperature of at least 70°C.
Serve with dates and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Nigerian-Style Chicken Pepper Soup
recipes.summary: A fiery, aromatic clear soup scented with ground spices, ginger and scotch bonnet.
steps: Put the chicken, water, onion, ginger, garlic, scotch bonnet and spices in a pot.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 30 minutes until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
Season with salt and add the basil for the last 2 minutes.
Serve hot in mugs or bowls.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Prick the scotch bonnet for more heat.

recipes.title: West African Groundnut Soup with Chicken
recipes.summary: A rich peanut and tomato soup with chicken, ginger and a little chilli.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes, then lift out.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the same pot for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes, cumin and scotch bonnet and cook for 8 minutes until pulpy.
Whisk in the peanut butter and stock, return the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the spinach until wilted and remove the scotch bonnet.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C.
Use pumpkin or sweet potato for a vegetarian version.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Borscht with Beef
recipes.summary: A deep red beetroot soup with beef, cabbage and potato, finished with sour cream and dill.
steps: Simmer the beef in the stock for 60 minutes until tender.
Fry the onion, carrot and beetroot in the oil for 10 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste and vinegar.
Add the potatoes to the pot and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beetroot mix and cabbage and simmer for 15 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Serve with the sour cream and dill.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until tender, with an internal temperature of at least 75°C.
The vinegar keeps the colour bright.

recipes.title: Root Vegetable Scotch Broth with Lamb Shoulder
recipes.summary: A hearty soup of lamb shoulder, pearl barley and root vegetables.
steps: Simmer the lamb with the barley and water, skimming off foam, for 40 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, leek, swede and thyme and simmer for 35 minutes until the lamb is tender and the barley soft.
Add the cabbage and cook for 5 minutes until just tender.
Season with salt and serve with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until tender, with an internal temperature of at least 70°C.
Soup thickens overnight, so loosen with stock.

recipes.title: Canh Chua Vietnamese Sour Fish Soup
recipes.summary: A tamarind-sour fish soup with tomato, pineapple and bean sprouts.
steps: Simmer the stock with the tamarind, garlic, fish sauce and sugar for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, pineapple and celery and simmer for 5 minutes until just soft.
Add the fish and cook gently for 4 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Stir in the sprouts and chilli and top with coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, with an internal temperature of at least 63°C.
Taste and balance the sour and sweet.

recipes.title: Tom Kha Gai Chicken Coconut Soup
recipes.summary: Galangal, lemongrass and lime leaf in a rich coconut broth with tender chicken.
steps: Simmer the stock, galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves for 10 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, mushrooms and chicken and simmer gently for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and chillies.
Top with coriander and serve without eating the whole aromatics.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
Do not boil hard or the coconut milk may split.

recipes.title: Korean Knife-Cut Noodle Soup with Chicken and Zucchini
recipes.summary: Hand-cut style wheat noodles in a clean chicken broth with zucchini and potato.
steps: Simmer the stock, chicken and garlic for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then lift out and shred.
Add the potato and simmer for 8 minutes until tender.
Add the noodles and zucchini and cook for 4 minutes until the noodles are tender.
Whisk the egg and stream it in, stirring until it sets in ribbons.
Season with soy and sesame oil and return the chicken.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the egg until fully set.
Top with kimchi if you like.

recipes.title: Tonjiru Japanese Pork and Vegetable Miso Soup
recipes.summary: A hearty miso soup stocked with pork, daikon, carrot and tofu.
steps: Fry the pork in the sesame oil for 4 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the dashi, daikon, carrot and potato and simmer for 12 minutes until tender.
Stir in the tofu and heat for 2 minutes.
Remove from the heat, whisk in the miso and serve with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches at least 70°C with no pink.
Do not boil the soup after adding miso.

recipes.title: Peppery Black Vinegar Soup with Pork, Tofu and Egg Ribbons
recipes.summary: A peppery vinegary soup of pork, mushrooms, tofu and ribbons of egg.
steps: Simmer the stock with the pork and mushrooms for 8 minutes until the pork is cooked through.
Add the tofu, vinegar, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir the cornflour with 3 tbsp water and add until the soup thickens slightly.
Stream in the whisked eggs, stirring gently until they form ribbons.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince until it reaches 75°C with no pink.
Cook the egg ribbons until fully set.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash Soup
recipes.summary: A paprika-rich beef and potato soup with caraway.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil for 6 minutes until coloured, then remove.
Cook the onions for 8 minutes until golden, then add the garlic, paprika, caraway and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return the beef and add the stock, then simmer for 60 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the potatoes and capsicum and simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Season with the salt and rest for 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until tender, with an internal temperature of at least 75°C.
Take the pan off the heat when adding paprika to avoid bitterness.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: Coconut rice with sambal, a fried egg, crispy anchovies, peanuts and cucumber.
steps: Cook the rice with the coconut milk, water, lime leaves and salt covered on low heat for 18 minutes until the grains are tender.
Fry the anchovies and peanuts in half the oil for 3 minutes until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set.
Serve the rice with the eggs, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber and sambal.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg whites until fully set, and refrigerate leftover rice within an hour.
Pandan leaves can replace the lime leaves if you can find them.

recipes.title: Kelewele Spiced Fried Plantain
recipes.summary: Ghanaian ripe plantain cubes tossed in ginger, chilli and cloves, fried until caramelised.
steps: Toss the plantain with the ginger, chilli, cloves, salt and lime juice.
Heat the oil to 175°C in a deep pan.
Fry in batches for 3 minutes until deep golden and crisp at the edges.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot with peanuts.
notes: Take care with hot oil.
Serve with roasted peanuts.

recipes.title: Suya Spice Rub and Yaji Mix
recipes.summary: A peanutty chilli spice mix for grilled meat, vegetables and tofu.
steps: Blitz the peanuts in a food processor until fine and sandy.
Mix with the paprika, ginger, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, salt and cloves.
Toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Store in a jar for up to 2 months.
notes: Food safety: when using the rub on chicken, cook to 75°C; on beef, cook to at least 70°C.
Rub on meat or vegetables with a little oil.

recipes.title: Shito Ghanaian Black Pepper Sauce
recipes.summary: A dark, savoury chilli oil sauce of dried shrimp, onions and ginger.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the onions for 15 minutes until deep golden.
Blitz the ginger, garlic and chillies to a paste and add with the shrimp and tomato paste.
Cook, stirring, for 20 minutes until dark and the oil separates.
Add the chilli flakes, salt and fish sauce and cook for 3 minutes.
Cool, then store in a clean jar.
notes: Keeps for 2 months in the fridge.
Serve with rice, eggs and fried plantain.

recipes.title: Nigerian Akara Bean Puffs with Scotch Bonnet
recipes.summary: Crisp, fluffy fried bean fritters from Nigeria, eaten for breakfast with pap or bread.
steps: Blitz the beans with the onion, scotch bonnet, salt and water to a thick, fluffy batter.
Beat the batter with a spoon for 2 minutes until it holds a peak.
Heat the oil to 175°C in a pan.
Spoon in tablespoons of batter and fry for 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked in the middle.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot.
notes: Take care with hot oil.
Use dried beans soaked overnight and peeled for the traditional texture.

recipes.title: Nuoc Cham Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: A sweet, sour, salty and spicy sauce for spring rolls, noodles and grilled meat.
steps: Stir the sugar into the warm water until dissolved.
Add the fish sauce and lime juice.
Stir in the garlic and chilli and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the balance until sweet, sour and salty.
notes: Keeps for 1 week in the fridge.
Use soy sauce for a vegetarian version.

recipes.title: Do Chua Pickled Carrot and Daikon
recipes.summary: A crunchy sweet pickle for banh mi, noodle bowls and grilled meats.
steps: Dissolve the sugar and salt in the warm water and vinegar.
Pack the carrot and daikon into a clean jar.
Pour over the pickling liquid until covered.
Chill for 2 hours until tangy and crisp.
notes: Keeps for 3 weeks in the fridge.
Salt the daikon first for 10 minutes for extra crunch.

recipes.title: Goi Ga Vietnamese Chicken and Cabbage Salad
recipes.summary: Shredded chicken, cabbage, carrot and herbs in a lime and fish sauce dressing.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes until cooked through, then cool and shred.
Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar.
Toss the chicken, cabbage, carrot, onion and herbs with the dressing.
Top with peanuts and fried shallots.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Dress just before serving.

recipes.title: Banh Mi Style Fried Eggs on Baguette
recipes.summary: Crisp baguette with fried eggs, pickles, chilli, coriander and a squirt of soy.
steps: Toast the baguette until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set and edges crisp.
Spread the baguette with the mayonnaise.
Fill with the eggs, cucumber, coriander, chilli and pickle.
Splash with the soy sauce and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg whites until fully set, and cook the yolks through for children and pregnant women.
Use the Do Chua pickle if you have it.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach and Tomato
recipes.summary: A savoury vegan scramble spiced with turmeric and smoked paprika.
steps: Heat the oil and add the tofu, turmeric, paprika and salt.
Cook, stirring, for 6 minutes until the tofu is golden and dry.
Add the tomato and spinach until the spinach is wilted.
Scatter with spring onion and serve.
notes: Serve on toast for breakfast.
The nutritional yeast adds a cheesy flavour.

recipes.title: Chickpea Flour Omelette with Herbs
recipes.summary: A vegan, high-protein savoury pancake with spring onion, coriander and chilli.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, turmeric, cumin and salt to a smooth batter.
Stir in the spring onions, coriander and chilli.
Heat half the oil in a non-stick pan and pour in half the batter.
Cook for 3 minutes until set and golden underneath, flip and cook for 2 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining batter.
notes: Serve with tomato chutney or yoghurt.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes for a softer texture.

recipes.title: High-Protein Egg White Frittata Cups
recipes.summary: Muffin-sized baked frittatas with spinach, feta and capsicum, easy to batch for the week.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 6-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, egg whites, salt and pepper.
Divide the spinach, capsicum, feta and spring onion among the holes.
Pour in the egg and bake for 18 minutes until puffed and set in the centre.
notes: Food safety: bake until the egg is completely set, with an internal temperature of at least 71°C.
Keeps for 4 days in the fridge or freezes well.

recipes.title: Lentil and Kale Salad with Lemon Tahini Dressing
recipes.summary: A hearty vegan, high-protein salad with warm lentils, kale, roasted pumpkin and a creamy dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and roast the pumpkin with 1 tbsp oil for 25 minutes until golden.
Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender but still holding their shape, then drain.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water and salt until creamy.
Toss the warm lentils with the kale, onion, pumpkin and remaining oil.
Drizzle with the dressing.
notes: Lightly massage the kale to soften it.
Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Edamame and Quinoa Salad with Sesame Dressing
recipes.summary: A gluten-free, vegan high-protein salad with edamame, quinoa, cucumber and a tamari dressing.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 400ml water for 15 minutes until the grains are tender with a visible curl.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes until bright green, then drain.
Whisk the tamari, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss the quinoa, edamame, cucumber, carrot and spring onions with the dressing.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and serve.
notes: Serve cold or at room temperature.
Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Caribbean Doubles with Curried Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Trinidad street-food breakfast of soft fried flatbreads topped with spiced chickpeas and tamarind sauce.
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, turmeric, salt, yeast and water to a soft dough, knead for 5 minutes and rest for 1 hour until doubled.
Fry the onion and garlic for 5 minutes until soft, then add the curry powder, chickpeas and a splash of water.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick and the chickpeas are very soft, mashing some.
Stir the tamarind and finely chopped scotch bonnet into a spoon of hot water for the sauce.
Flatten small balls of dough into thin rounds and fry in hot oil at 175°C for 30 seconds each side until puffed and pale gold.
Top two bara with the chickpeas and a drizzle of tamarind sauce.
notes: Rest time is not counted in the prep time.
Take care with hot oil.

recipes.title: Cuban-Style Black Bean Soup
recipes.summary: A smoky black bean soup with garlic, cumin and a splash of vinegar, topped with raw onion.
steps: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the beans, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Mash some beans, stir in the vinegar and top with the red onion.
notes: Serve with rice.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Supu ya Samaki Swahili Coconut Fish Soup
recipes.summary: A light, tangy fish and tomato soup from the Swahili coast with coconut milk, lime and coriander.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in a splash of coconut milk for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the turmeric, cumin and tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until pulpy.
Pour in the stock and remaining coconut milk and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the fish and simmer gently for 4 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Finish with the lime juice, coriander and salt.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, with an internal temperature of at least 63°C.
Serve with chapati or rice.

recipes.title: Timatim Ethiopian Tomato Salad
recipes.summary: Juicy tomatoes with onion, green chilli and a sharp lemon dressing.
steps: Combine the tomatoes, onion and chilli in a bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, garlic and salt.
Toss the dressing through the salad.
Rest for 5 minutes until the juices mingle, then serve.
notes: Serve with injera or flatbread.
Use ripe summer tomatoes for the best flavour.

recipes.title: Chapati Kenyan Layered Flatbread
recipes.summary: Soft, layered flatbreads rolled and fried until flaky, for dipping in stews.
steps: Mix the flour, salt and sugar, add the water and 1 tbsp oil and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Rest for 20 minutes, then divide into 6 balls.
Roll each ball thin, brush with oil, roll into a rope and coil into a spiral.
Roll out each spiral to 3mm thick.
Cook in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side, brushing with oil, until golden with brown spots.
notes: Resting time is not counted in the prep time.
Eat warm or wrap in a cloth to keep soft.

recipes.title: Githeri Kenyan Beans and Corn
recipes.summary: A rustic dish of beans and maize stewed with tomato and onion.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, coriander and tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until pulpy.
Stir in the beans, corn, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Serve topped with coriander.
notes: Add kale or cabbage if you want more greens.
Naturally vegan.

recipes.title: Zanzibar Spiced Pilau Rice
recipes.summary: Fragrant rice cooked with cumin, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 10 minutes until deep brown.
Add the cumin, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves for 1 minute, then the garlic and ginger.
Add the rinsed rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the stock and salt, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Rest for 10 minutes, then fluff.
notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within an hour, reheating until steaming hot.
Add cooked beef for a meat pilau.

recipes.title: Pancit Molo Filipino Wonton Soup
recipes.summary: Pork and prawn dumplings in a clear garlic chicken broth.
steps: Mix the pork, prawns, spring onion, soy sauce and pepper.
Spoon a teaspoon onto each wrapper, wet the edges and fold into parcels.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 2 minutes until golden, then add the stock and fish sauce and bring to a simmer.
Drop in the dumplings and cook for 6 minutes until they float and the filling is cooked through.
Top with the fried shallots and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the dumplings until the pork reaches 75°C and the prawns are pink and opaque.
Freeze uncooked dumplings for later.

recipes.title: Champorado Chocolate Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Filipino breakfast porridge of glutinous rice and cocoa, drizzled with milk.
steps: Simmer the rice in the water for 25 minutes, stirring, until soft and thick.
Stir in the cocoa, sugar and salt until dissolved.
Cook for 5 minutes until glossy.
Serve with the milk poured over.
notes: Add more water for a looser porridge.
Traditionally served with salty dried fish.

recipes.title: Perkedel Jagung Indonesian Corn Fritters
recipes.summary: Crisp corn fritters with spring onion and a hint of coriander.
steps: Mash half the corn with the garlic, then mix with the remaining corn, flour, egg, spring onions, coriander and salt.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Spoon in the batter and fry for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked in the middle.
Drain and serve with sambal.
notes: Food safety: cook the fritters until golden and fully set in the middle.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

recipes.title: Loco Moco Hawaiian Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: Rice topped with a beef patty, fried egg and rich onion gravy.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes until tender, then drain and keep warm.
Mix the mince with the salt and pepper, shape into two patties and fry for 4 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Fry the onion in the butter for 6 minutes until golden, stir in the flour, then add the stock and soy and simmer until thick.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set.
Serve the patties on rice with the eggs and gravy.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef patties until they reach 75°C with no pink.
Cook the egg whites until set.
